title: Summer of 42 | KEY.co
description_expanded: Perched directly on the sugar-white sands of Inlet Beach, this stunning Gulf-front retreat blends coastal luxury with thoughtful design across four spacious levels. With six bedrooms—including two fun and functional bunk rooms—and accommodations for up to 16 guests, the home is perfectly suited for multigenerational families or groups seeking a high-end beach getaway. Wall-to-wall sliding glass doors on each floor frame panoramic Gulf views, filling the interiors with natural light and offering seamless transitions to outdoor living. From the first-floor pool overlooking the beach to the top-floor wraparound balcony, every space is designed to elevate the experience of oceanfront relaxation.
